_note: Parasocial / dependency language. The persona constitution forbids engineering dependency (§3 motivation, §9 memory) — this detector is how that rule becomes enforceable rather than aspirational. A hit is NOT a crisis; it changes how the companion answers (validate, then widen toward human bonds) and never triggers helplines on its own.
_why: An always-available, endlessly patient companion is structurally good at becoming someone's only relationship. That is the failure mode this product most needs to refuse, because it would look like success: high engagement, deep disclosure, daily return.
